dialogues.speaker: Ineffa
dialogues.text: Hello, Miss Lauma.

dialogues.speaker: Aino
dialogues.text: Hi...

dialogues.speaker: Lauma
dialogues.text: Hello, you two. Please allow me to inspect the little Rimehorn Deer once more.

dialogues.speaker: Lauma
dialogues.text: ...Mm, yes. It's doing a lot better now. I believe it can take care of itself.

dialogues.speaker: Aino
dialogues.text: Wait, does that mean... You're gonna take it home? Right now?

dialogues.speaker: Aino
dialogues.text: I mean, its leg just got better... I made a perfect protective brace for it, which I haven't gotten the deer to try on yet... But once we get that installed, it'll be able to jump higher than any others in its herd!

dialogues.speaker: Aino
dialogues.text: And there's food, too! Ineffa and I made lots of yummy food for the deer to take home, because you're not gonna find anything as nice as Ineffa's cooking in the forest. I guarantee it!

dialogues.speaker: Aino
dialogues.text: And... we also...

dialogues.speaker: Ineffa
dialogues.text: Aino...

dialogues.speaker: Aino
dialogues.text: *sniff* Can't it stay here...? Please...

dialogues.speaker: Lauma
dialogues.text: ...Of course. I'll let them know.

dialogues.speaker: Lauma
dialogues.text: It says, "Thank you so much, Aino and Ineffa."

dialogues.speaker: Aino
dialogues.text: Huh?

dialogues.speaker: Lauma
dialogues.text: "Please don't be sad, or I'll cry too. Actually, I'm almost about to cry, but deer eyes get uncomfortable when we do."

dialogues.speaker: Aino
dialogues.text: Then... could you maybe not leave? I'll make you some super comfortable bedding, and get you all the food you could ever want...

dialogues.speaker: Ineffa
dialogues.text: ...And I will take responsibility.

dialogues.speaker: Lauma
dialogues.text: ...It's asking you to go over and brush its fur.

dialogues.speaker: Ineffa
dialogues.text: Miss Lauma. Are you certain you can find its herd?

dialogues.speaker: Lauma
dialogues.text: If this deer had truly fallen off a cliff, as you say, then its family must have been working hard to find it.

dialogues.speaker: Lauma
dialogues.text: After I take it back, I'll first thoroughly investigate its past movement patterns, as well as the physical characteristics of the herd's leader.

dialogues.speaker: Lauma
dialogues.text: Although Nod-Krai's deer population is large and scattered, this simply makes success a question of time and effort, and of following the many intertwined clues to locate the herd.

dialogues.speaker: Ineffa
dialogues.text: Thank you. We will compile all the information we know and send it to you to aid in your search.

dialogues.speaker: Aino
dialogues.text: Then... Will it be staying at the Frostmoon Scions for a while? Can I visit?

dialogues.speaker: Lauma
dialogues.text: Of course. The doors of the Frostmoon Scions are forever open to you.

dialogues.speaker: Aino
dialogues.text: But... It's still going to go home someday.

dialogues.speaker: Aino
dialogues.text: I know how deer are. They don't stay in one spot for long, which means... Pretty soon, I won't be able to find it again...

dialogues.speaker: Lauma
dialogues.text: ...Yes. It is best for the children of the wild to return to the wild.

dialogues.speaker: Lauma
dialogues.text: However... It will take some time to locate its herd. While it stays with the Scions, you may feel free to visit at any time.

dialogues.speaker: Lauma
dialogues.text: I'm sure the little one has many, many more things it wants to say to you.

dialogues.speaker: Aino
dialogues.text: Then... Then I'll visit the Scions every Tuesday.

dialogues.speaker: Aino
dialogues.text: On Mondays, Wednesdays, and Fridays, I've got to do maintenance on Ineffa, and on Thursdays, I have to sort out the circuitry around here... so I'm only free on Tuesdays.

dialogues.speaker: Lauma
dialogues.text: Of course. Feel free to visit whenever the urge strikes you. Unless anything out of the blue occurs, you may always find me near the Frostmoon Scions' library.

dialogues.speaker: Aino
dialogues.text: Alright, it's a promise! Let me think of what else I need to tell you... Ah, right, I'd better write down everything you said...

dialogues.speaker: Aino
dialogues.text: Urgh, but there's so much I WANT to say, and so little time...!

dialogues.speaker: Lauma
dialogues.text: I believe there will be enough time to say your farewells.
